options.content: Liveness, throughput, cursing, consensus and report-transmission signals for the commit plugin and the merkle-root processor, filtered by the `$destChain` / `$sourceChain` template variables above. All metrics here are Beholder-ingested (see `commit/metrics/prom.go`) unless noted — set the `DS_PROMETHEUS` dashboard datasource variable to whichever Grafana datasource serves your Beholder pipeline before relying on this. Full metric rationale: `docs/metrics/commit-metrics.md`.
**Step 0 of any triage**: is the plugin alive at all? A flat heartbeat means every other gauge below may simply be stale, not bad.

options.content: **Alert**: message `$MsgID`, onramp sequence number `$SeqNum`, chain `$sourceChain` (source) → chain `$destChain` (dest), reported in-flight for 15 minutes. Set the variables above, then walk the steps below top to bottom — each stops the moment you have an answer. This is a direct dashboard rendering of the "War games" walkthroughs in `docs/metrics/commit-metrics.md`; read that doc for the full rationale.

Check **OffRamp next seq num** for source `$sourceChain` → dest `$destChain`.

- `> $SeqNum` → a root covering it already landed on the offramp. Commit plugin's job is done; **hand off to exec on-call. Stop.**
- `<= $SeqNum` → continue to Step 2.

panels.title: Step 1 — Is this even a commit-plugin problem?

options.content:
Check **OnRamp max seq num** for source `$sourceChain`.

- `< $SeqNum` → onramp read is lagging. Check the errors-by-reason panel below (no_bindings / timeout / rpc_error). This is a source-chain read/infra issue, not commit logic. **Stop here and escalate to chain infra.**
- `>= $SeqNum` → plugin has seen it; continue to Step 3.

panels.title: Step 2 — Has the plugin observed it on-chain yet?

options.content:
Check **rate(ccip_commit_consensus_observation_failed_total[5m])** for dest `$destChain`.

- Incrementing → destination-chain-wide consensus failure. Jump to the **Scenario 3 deep dive** below.
- Flat → continue to Step 4.

panels.title: Step 3 — Is the round producing outcomes at all?

options.content:
Check **RMN curse active** for dest `$destChain` and **source chain cursed** for `$sourceChain`.

- Any `== 1` → found it; likely intentional/incident-flagged, hand off to whoever owns the curse. **Stop.**
- All `0` → continue to Step 5.

panels.title: Step 4 — Is chain A or B cursed?

options.content:
Check **report_transmission_gave_up** and **report_transmission_attempts** for `$sourceChain` / `$destChain`.

- Incrementing/maxed → jump to the **Scenario 2 deep dive** below.
- Otherwise → likely just backlog size; check **pending_messages** and estimate ETA from round cadence.

panels.title: Step 5 — Is a report being built but never landing?
Step 5 metric — gave up & pending backlog

⚠️ RMN-signature branches (signed-roots-dropped, chain quorum, Byzantine root disagreement) were dropped from this runbook: RMNEnabled is hardcoded off in production. Cursing (Step 4) is the one RMN-adjacent signal still live.

options.content:
Three hypotheses, cheapest first:

- **A — never transmitted (rejected pre-send).** Check the reason breakdown below for `phase="should_transmit"`. `config_digest_mismatch` → cross-check the digest-mismatch panel above, config sync issue. `stale` → often benign, a different overlapping report already landed, re-check Step 1. `dest_not_supported` → transmission-schedule/config bug. `cursed` → converges with Step 4. All flat → move to B.
- **B — transmitted, reverted/stuck on-chain.** *Outside commit-plugin metrics*: check chain B's TXM/tx-sender dashboards for the assigned transmitter (nonce gap, underpriced gas, wallet balance, revert reason).
- **C — actually succeeded, read is lagging.** `offramp_next_seq_num` is sourced from this plugin's own chain-B reader; cross-check chain B's block explorer / chain-reader health directly before escalating further.

panels.title: Deep dive: Scenario 2 — report transmission stuck (Step 5)

options.content:
Grounded in `getConsensusObservation` (`merkleroot/outcome.go`): the *only* way the whole round fails is the DON not reaching 2·fRoleDON+1 agreement on a single FChain value for the **destination chain** — every other field degrades gracefully per-chain.

- **This is destination-chain-wide, not lane-specific.** Before going further, check whether *other* source chains into this dest are also stalled (their pending-messages also climbing, panel below). If only `$sourceChain` is affected, this branch is wrong — back to Step 4/5.
- **H1 — too few oracles could read it.** `fchain_read_errors` spiking broadly across oracles → home-chain RPC/read outage.
- **H2 — oracles disagree.** *(Needs the not-yet-implemented `consensus.go` split-vote metric — `ccip_commit_consensus_dropped{objectName="fChain", reason="split"}`, reviewed design only per the metrics doc.)* Corroborate with `config_digest_mismatch` flipping for a subset of oracles around the same time.
